definitions.gloss: kundoku; reading classical Chinese as Japanese
definitions.explanation: The traditional technique of reading a classical Chinese text ({漢文|かんぶん}) directly as Japanese: the reader follows marks that reorder the words into Japanese order and supplies particles and verb endings. It is taught in Japanese high schools as part of classical literature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訓読|くんどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To read a classical Chinese text as Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訓読|くんどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: The method of reading classical Chinese in Japanese word order is taught in high school classics class.

examples.japanese: {返|かえ}り{点|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼り：14634_tayori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訓読|くんどく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧みた。
examples.english: Using the reordering marks as a guide, I tried reading the classical Chinese text as Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訓読|くんどく}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: In the past, Japanese readers read the Chinese classics as Japanese by means of kundoku.

notes:
{訓読|くんどく} names the method of reading ⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧ as Japanese. Marks added to the Chinese text, such as {返|かえ}り{点|てん} (reordering marks) and ⟦{送|おく}り{仮名|がな}→送り仮名：15047_okurigana⟧, tell the reader what order to read in and which endings to add. Writing the result out in kanji and kana gives a ⟦{書|か}き{下|くだ}し{文|ぶん}→書き下し文：22266_kakikudashibun⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訓読|くんどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to read a classical Chinese text as Japanese
- ⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧{訓読|くんどく}: kanbun kundoku (the full term)
- {訓読|くんどく}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧: a text in kundoku style

WATCH OUT:
The spelling {訓読|くんよみ}, without み, is sometimes read くんよみ as a variant of ⟦{訓読|くんよ}み→訓読み：10454_kunyomi⟧, the native Japanese reading of a single kanji (as in ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ read やま). Read くんどく, the word means only the reading of classical Chinese. For a kanji's kun reading, use {訓読|くんよ}み, paired with ⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧.
